==Notes==
*Cheap [[spell]]s with a low [[recharge time]] combine better with this enchantment.
**5 energy spells receive 20...80% energy reduction, while 10 energy spells receive only 10...40% energy reduction.
**This [[skill]] does not reduce the healing from [[Divine Favor]].
*This skill does not reduce the healing from enchantments, except [[Patient Spirit]]. For details, see [[Heal#Healing modifiers|healing modifiers]].
*NPCs don't maintain this enchantment out of combat, unlike [[Unyielding Aura]] and [[Divine Boon]].
